title: REQ · FileStore.FrozenIDs reader is covered by temp-dir tests
summary: Frozen-ids reader is proven with a temp-dir snapshot and fake committer
description: Context: FileStore.FrozenIDs reads snapshot.yaml for a world and round and returns the ids in order, ErrNotFound when missing and an error for unsafe path segments. Desired behavior: unit tests cover these three cases. Expected result: tests pass. Why: the exporter relies on it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a snapshot.yaml listing a then b, When FrozenIDs runs, Then it returns [a b]
Given no snapshot, When FrozenIDs runs, Then the error is ErrNotFound
Given world ../x or round a/b, When FrozenIDs runs, Then a non-ErrNotFound error is returned
technical_constraints: Filesystem only under t.TempDir; fakeCommitter for git
